text:
matt: heads-up — promotion for release/2026.03.20 is blocked by CI. promote-to-prod job failed during image push step, reporting a digest mismatch.
ci-bot: [automated] promote-to-prod #342 failed: computed digest does not match registry digest. see job logs: https://ci.internal/reports/342
ryan: I saw this once — could be a registry-side dedupe/rotation race. The builder uploaded image A, then another build pushed image B with same tag before promotion validated digest.
sarah: logs show the builder produced image tag `redwood/release:2026.03.20` with digest `sha256:aaa111`, but registry returned `sha256:bbb222` on promote-step.
aj: is the artifact storage using mutable tags? we should be using immutable digests for promotion. if the tag got re-used, promotion should fail — which is correct behavior.
matt: agree, but we need a release decision for the change window. options: 1) abort promote and hold release; 2) rollback to previous stable tag; 3) re-run CI with pinned digest after fixing upstream. thoughts?
kate: short-term: pin to digest and re-run promote job. long-term: make CI publish immutable artifact references (create a canonical digest file) and make the deploy step use that.
ci-bot: recent pipeline run (build #341) produced artifact metadata file at `artifacts/2026.03.20/metadata.json` with digest `sha256:aaa111`. promote job used tag only.
ryan: we can hotfix by re-running the create-metadata job and then triggering promote with `--digest sha256:aaa111`. aj, can you hand-edit the deploy job to accept digest?
aj: yes I can. I'll queue a manual promote with digest pinned. running: `./ci/cli promote --release 2026.03.20 --digest sha256:aaa111 --env prod`
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod is paused by safeguard: tag-not-stable. Manual override requires @matt OK.
matt: I approve manual override for this window. Proceed but hold canary at 5% until we validate latency/trace.
sarah: note — helm charts reference image tag in `charts/release/values.yaml`. we'll update chart to use digest notation `image: "redwood/release@sha256:aaa111"` for canary.
aj: doing that now, running helm template locally to lint. output shows no issues.
ci-bot: lint job `helm-lint` passed in local run; remote lint job previously failed on chart-signature check because packaging step regenerated the chart tar before digest pinned.
kate: after we get canary healthy for 10 minutes, we can either continue rollout or rollback if we see errors. monitor: traces + token-latency dashboard.
matt: thanks. aj, please post final status here when promote completes or if any new digests appear.
aj: promote started with pinned digest. watch link: https://ci.internal/promote/342/monitor
ci-bot: promote-to-prod #342 completed successfully using digest sha256:aaa111. canary at 5%.
ryan: monitoring looks clean so far, no error spikes.
matt: ok keep canary for 15m then 50% then full. log actions here.
ci-bot: update: canary -> 50% at 1945680300.
sarah: updating release notes to mention manual digest pin and follow-up ticket for immutable-tag enforcement: https://jira.internal/browse/REL-317
aj: closing thread when rollout hits 100%.
ci-bot: rollout completed to 100% at 1945680456.
matt: closing — root cause: mutable tag reuse/race. follow-ups: REL-317 (immutable artifacts) and INF-502 (registry hardening). :thumbsup:
